lessons_used: Evidence is still thin to establish rules for specific kinds of changes, as no change type has been tested at least twice.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as no test has yielded a statistically significant win.

candidates.title: Delay Sign In After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet selection and photo upload so users choose their pet before creating or logging into an account.
candidates.why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% early on, causing early friction before users build attachment to their pet.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact by delaying friction step after user engagement, but requires complete reordering.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Check Screen
candidates.change: Add a new desktop preview screen during adoption to verify pet rendering on the user's desktop screen before proceeding.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple bug reports where pets fail to show on the desktop or the app stalls before rendering.

pick_friend.hint: Next, verify how your pet looks on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_desktop_check']

candidates.title: Home Desktop Controls Quickstart Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a split visual layout highlighting essential desktop controls for summoning, dragging, and hiding the pet.
candidates.why: Finish drop-off is high (64.8%) and support reports confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Learn quick shortcuts to interact with, move, or hide your companion anytime.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Wait Time Progress and Activity Flow
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive multi-step preview flow with estimated completion time, progress status, and pet tip carousel.
candidates.why: The waiting step has an extremely high mean time of 2336s and 81.3% conversion, leaving users uncertain while assets generate.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Pet Assets
waiting.body: We are generating your desktop pet animations. Relax or set a system alert!

components.text: Tip: You can drag your pet across multi-monitor setups anytime.

guard.reason: Adding wait time progress, completion estimates, and tip carousel to the waiting screen is permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 2336s wait time at home step with interactive preview flow, though requires new screens.

candidates.title: Account Restore Clarification Notice
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in restores missing pets and syncs accounts safely.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Sign in with your existing account to prevent pet resets and keep your desktop companions safe.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to clarify account sync does not violate any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between sign_in drop-off and 8 support tickets; quick copy config fix.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Upload Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add explicit formatting and lighting guidance hints on the upload photos screen to ensure successful custom pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with a single centered subject.

guard.reason: Adding photo formatting and lighting hints to the upload screen is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop step (adoption 60.9%) supported by ticket reports of generation failure.

candidates.title: Background Generation Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Add a desktop ready notification toggle and delay tip to the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336 seconds, indicating users wait extended periods without clear indication of background status.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize this window. We will notify you when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adding background notification toggles and delay hints to the waiting screen is permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait time on home step by adding background notification toggle.

candidates.title: Choose Path Compact Layout Restructure
candidates.change: Switch choose_path to a compact layout with step counters to reduce visual clutter and decision fatigue.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and has a long mean completion time (514s).

choose_path.headline: Select Your Adoption Journey
choose_path.body: Choose standard adoption or create a custom pet companion.

guard.reason: Restructuring choose_path into a compact layout with step counters is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Layout redesign targeted at 23.8% initial drop, though previous redesign test showed negative lift.

candidates.title: Path Selection Starter Trait Banner
candidates.change: Add a playful mascot banner component on choose_path encouraging users to pick a path to unlock companion traits.
candidates.why: Over 23% of users abandon at the initial path selection step.

components.text: Select a path to unlock unique desktop behaviors for your pet!

guard.reason: Adding a playful mascot banner component on choose_path is permitted and does not violate copy or pricing rules.

candidates.score_note: Incentivizes initial path selection where 23.8% of users drop off.

candidates.title: Desktop Shortcut Tray Notification
candidates.change: Show a taskbar tray notification hint on home_intro when onboarding finishes.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%, and post-onboarding confusion regarding pet access is common in support logs.

home_intro.hint: Your pet is now live! Access quick controls anytime from your system taskbar tray.

guard.reason: Adding a system taskbar tray notification hint to home_intro is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Helps retention at finish step backed by post-onboarding support issues, but requires native release.

picked: Delay Sign In After Pet Selection
